newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche to bring mark repo business to Germany - Breuer. [corrected 16:25 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Deutsche to bring mark repo business to Germany - Breuer. [corrected 16:25 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear this refers to mark repo business only.)

Deutsche Bank AG management board member Rolf Breuer said on Wednesday that Deutsche, the largest German commercial bank, would pull all its securities repurchase business in marks to Frankfurt from London.
Breuer, who is soon to replace Hilmar Kopper as Deutsche management board chairman, was speaking in a panel discussion also attended by Bundesbank council member Ernst Welteke.

The Bundesbank last December exempted securities repurchase business involving maturities of up to one year from minimum reserve requirements -- which oblige banks to hold non-interest bearing deposits at the German central bank.
